title: Open the PS2 system menu for a BIOS boot check

Open the PS2 system menu for a BIOS boot check

blocks.text: PCSX2’s command-line reference says `-bios` starts the BIOS system menu, also called OSDSYS. This is a useful controlled check when you need to see whether the emulator can start your own BIOS dump independently of a selected game. It does not supply firmware: PCSX2 requires you to provide a BIOS dumped from a console you own, and this guide does not link firmware downloads.

Use a personal BIOS dump obtained from your own console and a PCSX2 installation configured to recognize it. Close other emulator instances and note the usual launch shortcut. If the BIOS is not configured or its region is unknown, resolve that through the official setup documentation before interpreting this test.

items: 1. Open the PCSX2 executable folder or the terminal/shortcut you use for normal launches.
2. Start PCSX2 with the `-bios` option and no game-image filename.
3. Wait for the BIOS system menu to appear; do not load a game or change firmware settings during this check.
4. Note any on-screen region/language indicators and whether the menu responds to the controller.
5. Close the emulator normally, then launch one known game using the usual game-list workflow.
6. Compare the system-menu boot and game boot results; record which stage fails.

blocks.text: The BIOS check passes when PCSX2 reaches the system menu using the configured personal firmware. A successful menu boot proves the firmware path can start; it does not prove a game image is valid or that the game is compatible. If a game boots directly with fast boot, that is a separate path and does not disprove that `-bios` worked.

items: PCSX2 reports no usable BIOS: verify that your own dump is installed and selected in the emulator configuration.
A game starts instead: remove any game filename from the test command.
The menu appears but controls do not: verify a controller mapping independently; BIOS boot alone does not test game input.
The menu is in an unexpected language or region: inspect the selected personal BIOS dump; do not download another firmware image.

blocks.text: Close PCSX2 and remove `-bios` from the temporary shortcut or command. Return to your normal launcher and boot the intended game from the library. This test does not modify BIOS contents or game data.
